integrity: Uniform ordinary simplicial free-face collapse and standard simply-connected CW arguments provide a self-contained infinite proof. The checker uses exact finite enumeration and GF(2) arithmetic, not numerical estimates.
scientific_limitations: Filled clique complexes of squared cycles at tolerance one and n >= 9 only; no equivariant or higher-tolerance assertion. Finite computations are corroborative rather than proofs of the infinite quantifier. Publication priority and all mathematics require independent assessment.
title: Quadratic sphere wedges in one-tolerance complexes of squared cycles
